## Install

Download `mcp-obsidian.mcpb` below and double-click it. Claude Desktop will
walk you through:

1. **Obsidian API Key** — paste the API key from the Local REST API
   community plugin's settings in Obsidian (see
   [README](https://github.com/MarkusPfundstein/mcp-obsidian#obsidian-rest-api-key)
   for setup instructions).
2. **Obsidian Host / Port** — defaults to `127.0.0.1` / `27124`; only
   change these if you've reconfigured the plugin.
3. **Install** — confirms and registers the Obsidian MCP tools.

Requires the [Local REST API](https://github.com/coddingtonbear/obsidian-local-rest-api)
community plugin installed and enabled in Obsidian, and `uv`/`uvx` on your
`PATH`.
